name: stealth_jet_final
cmd:
O=$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/out/stealth_jet_final; mkdir -p $O
python3 robot_build.py -- --robot stealth_jet --out $O --stage sculpt --fine --shots $O/shots > $O/sculpt.log 2>&1 || (tail -40 $O/sculpt.log; exit 1)
python3 robot_build.py -- --robot stealth_jet --out $O --stage game --tex 2048 --ao 24 > $O/game.log 2>&1 || (tail -40 $O/game.log; exit 1)
python3 robot_build.py -- --robot stealth_jet --out $O --stage export > $O/export.log 2>&1 || (tail -40 $O/export.log; exit 1)
for b in $O/*_hq.blend; do python3 robot_icon.py -- $b $O/strip --strip > $O/strip.log 2>&1 || tail -20 $O/strip.log; done
rm -f $O/robot_hi.blend $O/robot_game.blend
ls -la $O

name: hunter_killer_final
cmd:
O=$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/out/hunter_killer_final; mkdir -p $O
python3 robot_build.py -- --robot hunter_killer --out $O --stage sculpt --fine --shots $O/shots > $O/sculpt.log 2>&1 || (tail -40 $O/sculpt.log; exit 1)
python3 robot_build.py -- --robot hunter_killer --out $O --stage game --tex 2048 --ao 24 > $O/game.log 2>&1 || (tail -40 $O/game.log; exit 1)
python3 robot_build.py -- --robot hunter_killer --out $O --stage export > $O/export.log 2>&1 || (tail -40 $O/export.log; exit 1)
for b in $O/*_hq.blend; do python3 robot_icon.py -- $b $O/strip --strip > $O/strip.log 2>&1 || tail -20 $O/strip.log; done
for b in $O/*_hq.blend; do python3 robot_icon.py -- $b $O/strip2 --strip --action Summon --every 2 > $O/strip2.log 2>&1 || tail -20 $O/strip2.log; done
rm -f $O/robot_hi.blend $O/robot_game.blend
ls -la $O
